correctness.rationale: For hyperbolic three-space curvature -1 and a>1, the spherical function sin(lambda r)/(lambda sinh r), radial measure 4pi sinh²r dr and elementary Laplace sine transforms give \hat f(lambda)=8pi a P(lambda²)/(D_{a-1}D_{a+1}), with P(u)=u²+2(a²+omega²+1)u+(a²-1)²-2(a²+1)omega²-3omega^4. Both D factors are strictly positive and P is strictly increasing for u>=0. Thus the spectral sign on the entire real principal series is decided by P(0), and solving P(0)>=0 yields 3omega^4+2(a²+1)omega² <=(a²-1)² exactly, equality included. Spherical inversion as a positive mixture of positive-definite principal spherical kernels gives sufficiency; radial Plancherel plus the dense compact-test convolution form gives necessity for a>1, and negative P(0) creates an open interval of negative spectrum. Exact independently derived SymPy rational-numerator identity matched and four a-values were sampled; analytic monotonicity is the infinite part of proof.
